translations.web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
translations.bsb: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
translations.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
translations.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
